label: H.R. 9334
title: Workforce for AI Trust Act

items.snippet: This bill provides for various workforce development and research programs related to artificial intelligence (AI).

items.item: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
items.snippet: For example, the bill authorizes the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) to support education and workforce development activities to expand careers in the AI workforce.
Separately, the National Science Foundation (NSF) may make awards through eligible institutions of higher education to support graduate and postdoctoral…

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

L000397.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
L000397.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
